arxiv-1903-01744.title: Scaling Features of Price-Volume Cross Correlation Journal: Physica A
arxiv-1903-01744.creator: Jamshid Ardalankia, Mohammad Osoolian, Emmanuel Haven, G.Reza Jafari
arxiv-1903-01744.description: Abstract Price without transaction makes no sense. Trading volume authenticates its corresponding price, so there exists mutual information and correlation between price and trading volume. We are curious about fractal features of this correlation and need to know how structures in different scales translate information.

arxiv-2101-02210.title: Higher-form and (non-)Stückelberg symmetries in non-equilibrium systems
arxiv-2101-02210.creator: Michael J. Landry
arxiv-2101-02210.description: Abstract We investigate the role of higher-form symmetries in non-equilibrium systems from the perspective of effective actions defined on the Schwinger-Keldysh contour. To aid our investigation, we extend the coset construction to account for p p -form symmetries at zero and finite temperature.

arxiv-2109-12909.title: Compressive Visual Representations
arxiv-2109-12909.creator: Kuang-Huei Lee, Anurag Arnab † \dagger, Sergio Guadarrama, John Canny, Ian Fischer † \dagger
arxiv-2109-12909.description: Abstract Learning effective visual representations that generalize well without human supervision is a fundamental problem in order to apply Machine Learning to a wide variety of tasks. Recently, two families of self-supervised methods, contrastive learning and latent bootstrapping, exemplified by SimCLR and BYOL respectively, have made significant progress.

arxiv-2211-04146.title: Control-Flow-Based Querying of Process Executions from Partially Ordered Event Data
arxiv-2211-04146.creator: Daniel Schuster, Michael Martini, Sebastiaan J. van Zelst, Wil M. P. van der Aalst
arxiv-2211-04146.description: Abstract Event logs, as viewed in process mining, contain event data describing the execution of operational processes. Most process mining techniques take an event log as input and generate insights about the underlying process by analyzing the data provided. Consequently, handling large volumes of event data is essential to apply process mining successfully.

arxiv-2302-14591.title: A universal equation to predict Ω m \Omega_{\rm m} from halo and galaxy catalogues
arxiv-2302-14591.creator: Helen Shao, Natalí S. M. de Santi, Francisco Villaescusa-Navarro, Romain Teyssier, Yueying Ni, Daniel Anglés-Alcázar, Shy Genel, Ulrich P. Steinwandel, Elena Hernández-Martínez, Klaus Dolag, Christopher C. Lovell, Lehman H. Garrison, Eli Visbal, Mihir Kulkarni, Lars Hernquist, Tiago Castro, Mark Vog
arxiv-2302-14591.description: Abstract We discover analytic equations that can infer the value of Ω m \Omega_{\rm m} from the positions and velocity moduli of halo and galaxy catalogues. The equations are derived by combining a tailored graph neural network (GNN) architecture with symbolic regression.

arxiv-2407-09362.title: Structure and Independence in Hyperbolic Uniform Disk Graphs
arxiv-2407-09362.creator: Thomas Bläsius, Jean-Pierre von der Heydt, Sándor Kisfaludi-Bak, Marcus Wilhelm, Geert van Wordragen
arxiv-2407-09362.description: Abstract We consider intersection graphs of disks of radius r r in the hyperbolic plane. Unlike the Euclidean setting, these graph classes are different for different values of r r , where very small r r corresponds to an almost-Euclidean setting and r ∈ Ω ⁡ ( log ⁡ n ) r\in\Omega(\log n) corresponds to a firmly hyperbolic setting.

arxiv-2410-15507.title: Coisotropic embeddings of precosymplectic manifolds
arxiv-2410-15507.creator: Manuel de León, Pablo Soto Martín
arxiv-2410-15507.description: Abstract In this paper we provide a complete characterisation of coisotropic embeddings of precosymplectic manifolds into cosymplectic manifolds. This result extends a theorem of Gotay about coisotropic embeddings of presymplectic manifolds. We also extend to the cosymplectic case some results of A. Weinstein which generalise the Darboux theorem.

arxiv-2503-18237.title: A Curationary Tale: Logarithmic Regret in DeFi Lending via Dynamic Pricing
arxiv-2503-18237.creator: Tarun Chitra
arxiv-2503-18237.description: Abstract Lending within decentralized finance (DeFi) has facilitated over $100 billion of loans since 2020. A long-standing inefficiency in DeFi lending protocols such as Aave is the use of static pricing mechanisms for loans. These mechanisms have been shown to maximize neither welfare nor revenue for participants in DeFi lending protocols.

arxiv-2512-02463.title: A Datalake for Data-driven Social Science Research
arxiv-2512-02463.creator: Puneet Aryapuneet.arya@ashoka.edu.in, Ojas Sahasrabudhe, Adwaiya Srivastav, Pratha Pratim Dasppd@ashoka.edu.in, Maya Ramanathramanath@cse.iitd.ac.in
arxiv-2512-02463.description: Abstract Social science research increasingly demands data-driven insights, yet researchers often face barriers such as lack of technical expertise, inconsistent data formats, and limited access to reliable datasets. In this paper, we present a Datalake infrastructure tailored to the needs of interdisciplinary social science research.

europmc-pmc4963825.description: Since ochratoxin A (OTA) was discovered, it has been ubiquitous as a natural contaminant of moldy food and feed. pmc-10597255.title: Longitudinal clustering of risk behaviours and their association with multimorbidity in older adults
pmc-10597255.creator: A Suhag, T L Webb, J Holmes
pmc-10597255.description: Smoking, unhealthy nutrition, alcohol consumption, and physical inactivity (SNAP risk behaviours) are leading risk factors for multimorbidity and tend to cluster within specific subpopulations. Little is known about how these clusters change with age in older adults and their association with multimorbidity.

pmc-10863787.title: Immune Activation Mediates the Association of Advanced Hepatic Fibrosis With Adverse Outcomes in Patients With Coronary Artery Disease
pmc-10863787.creator: Vardhmaan Jain, Anurag Mehta, Terence B Lee, Chang Liu, Nicholas W S Chew, Yi‐An Ko, Matthew E Gold, Daniel A Gold, Nishant Vatsa, Shivang R Desai, Jonathan H Kim, Alireza Rahbar, Yazan Haroun, Kiran Ejaz, Salim S Hayek, Mohammad S Siddiqui, Fadi N Salloum, Laurence S Sperling, Arun J Sanyal, Arshed
pmc-10863787.description: BackgroundLiterature suggests a bidirectional association between advanced hepatic fibrosis (AHF) and coronary artery disease (CAD). We evaluated the association of AHF with immune activation, systemic inflammation, and adverse outcomes in patients with CAD.Methods and ResultsA fibrosis‐4 index cutoff value ≥2.67 was used to define AHF.

pmc-11546216.title: Cost of “Ideal Minimum Integrated Care” for Type 2 Diabetes and Hypertension Patients in Cambodia Context: Provider Perspective
pmc-11546216.creator: Sokunthea Yem, Srean Chhim, Edwin Wouters, Josefien Van Olmen, Por Ir, Grace Marie Ku
pmc-11546216.description: Introduction:As in other countries worldwide, Diabetes mellitus type 2 (T2D) and hypertension (HTN) prevalence is increasing in Cambodia. The country is examining models to scale-up integrated T2D and HTN care. However, costs of integrated care in this setting are not yet well-understood.

pmc-12598432.title: Stemness-based gastric cancer classification by machine learning for precision diagnosis and treatment of gastric cancer
pmc-12598432.creator: Shixin Zhou, Chenyu Tian, Tao Zhu, Hao Chen, Changxin Chen, Quan Jiang, Fenglin Liu
pmc-12598432.description: BackgroundStemness has been shown to play an important role in immunotherapy and chemotherapy response. Machine learning has been used to predict stemness-based cancer subtypes. We aimed to conduct a stemness-based classification of gastric cancer (GC) for the early identification of patients at risk for GC and guide treatment.

pmc-13231626.title: Emotional pathways linking relative deprivation experiences to conspiracy beliefs: a mini-meta-analysis
pmc-13231626.creator: Katharina Abad Borger, Eva Walther
pmc-13231626.description: BackgroundConspiracy beliefs pose a societal challenge, yet the processes through which they emerge remain debated. One pathway to conspiracy beliefs that has received limited attention is the role of emotional responses to relative deprivation (RD). RD — the perception of being unfairly disadvantaged— elicits negative emotions such as anger and disgust, which may in turn foster conspiratorial interpretations.
